Veergati is an intense 1995 Hindi action-drama. The story follows Ajay, an honest man fighting corrupt forces, injustice, and crime to defend the innocent. Watch this full movie compilation featuring powerful performances, emotional drama, and iconic fight sequences.
Viragti (1995) ek jabardast ekshan aur drama philm hai. yah kahani hai ajay ki, jo samaj men phaile apradh aur anyay ke khilaph nidar hokar larta hai. is phul muvi kanpaileshan men dekhie salman khan ka shandar abhinay, bhavnaen aur behatrin ekshan sina.
Movie : Veergati (1995)
